equation_request.abstract:
We show a perfect state transfer of an arbitrary unknown two-qubit state can be achieved via a discrete-time quantum walk with various settings of coin flippings, and extend this method to distribution of an arbitrary unknown multi-qubit entangled state between every pair of sites in the multi-dimensional network. Furthermore, we study the routing of quantum information on this network in a quantum walk architecture, which can be used as quantum information processors to communicate between separated qubits.

- 03.67.Ac, 03.67.Lx, 03.67.Bg, 03.67.Hk

specification.problem: Perfect transfer of an unknown two-qubit state across a small qubit chain by a mirror-symmetric XX+YY (Christandl/Krawtchouk) evolution, used as a stand-in for the abstract's discrete-time quantum walk with coin flips. Verified by an undo-preparation fidelity check. No black box, so zero queries.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One instance: chain of N=4 site qubits (optionally up to 6), two-qubit state on sites 0,1 transferred to sites N-1,N-2, no ancillas. Outside scope: the actual coined-walk construction, multi-dimensional hypercube distribution to every pair, multi-qubit entangled state distribution, and routing by stopping times. These are sketched only as extensions.

symbols.meaning: number of site qubits in the chain

symbols.domain: real, t=\pi/2 in units where J_j=\sqrt{j(N-j)}

symbols.meaning: standard-gate circuit preparing the test two-qubit state from |00>

equations.label: Chain Hamiltonian
equations.description: Engineered-coupling XX chain with Krawtchouk profile, sites indexed 1..N here. Bond terms XX and YY commute on one bond, so each bond is exactly RXX*RYY. Different bonds do not commute, so a full evolution needs Trotter steps or the exact spin-J rotation property.
equations.justification: Christandl et al. perfect-state-transfer chain, recalled from background. It is not stated in the abstract.
assumptions: Single-excitation subspace acts as a spin-(N-1)/2 J_x rotation

equations.label: Mirror transfer
equations.description: In the one-excitation sector, the evolution maps site j to site N+1-j up to phases. Phases are corrected locally by Z rotations. Sector phases are consistent for multi-excitation sectors by free-fermion structure (Jordan-Wigner).
equations.justification: Known PST property. Sign and phase conventions must be verified numerically. The phase is linear in j, so it is correctable by S-type gates on the output sites.
assumptions: Time unit matches eq_1 so that the Hamiltonian rotation angle at time t is pi over the spin-J rotation
Jordan-Wigner string signs are handled by checking numerically

equations.label: Bond gate
equations.description: Circuit gate for each bond for a Trotter step of duration tau. With r steps, tau=t/r, applied in a bond-layer order. Qiskit RXX(theta)=exp(-i theta XX/2).
equations.justification: Concrete gate realization from the sketch. Trotter error is nonzero unless r is large. For N=4, instead use a free-fermion/numerical decomposition or large r, since the circuit is only small.
assumptions: Trotter error is tolerated, or the evolution is compiled exactly by other means

equations.label: Overall transfer with relabeling
equations.description: The output on sites N-1,N-2 holds the input state with qubit order reversed. Reading the output with the order swapped gives the original state.
equations.abstract_quote: perfect state transfer of an arbitrary unknown two-qubit state
equations.justification: The abstract claims two-qubit state transfer. The mirror order reversal is inferred from the chain sketch, not from the abstract.
assumptions: Initial state on the remaining sites is all-zero

equations.label: Fidelity readout
equations.description: After evolution, apply U_prep^dagger on the output sites with the order swapped and phase corrections. Measure those two sites. P(00) equals F, which should be near 1. Other sites should be 0 and need not be measured.
equations.justification: Standard undo-preparation test from the sketch.
assumptions: Input state is pure, prepared by U_prep from |00>
Measure only output bits, mapping Qiskit little-endian bit i to the qubit measured into bit i

registers.name: site
registers.role: chain qubits. Sites 0,1 at the input end hold the state, sites N-2,N-1 are the output.

specification.initial_state: U_prep on sites 0,1 from |00>, all other sites |0>.

steps.description: Prepare a random two-qubit state on sites 0,1 with a standard gate circuit U_prep.
Apply r Trotter steps of the bond gates with couplings J_j over total time pi/2. Use brickwork ordering of odd and even bonds.
Apply local Z/S phase corrections on the output sites and relabel the order (the mirror reverses it).
Apply U_prep^dagger on the output sites with the swapped order, then measure those two qubits.

specification.measurement: Measure only the two output site qubits N-2 and N-1 after U_prep^dagger. The all-zero probability is the fidelity. Check bit order in the little-endian counts key.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate F as the fraction of 00 outcomes. If a statevector is read, compute the overlap directly.
assumptions: Chosen construction: spin-chain PST replaces the coined walk, which is not given in the abstract.
Phase corrections are found numerically by a calibration, not given in the abstract.
Zero queries because there is no black box.
missing_information: Actual coin-flip walk operators and their settings
Hypercube/grid distribution to all pairs and multi-qubit entangled state distribution
Exact phase-correction schedule and exact time units
